page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This configuration runs on a KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead.

For acceleration, the instance integrates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers between the instance and external storage or other network resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge offers a dense multi-GPU configuration suitable for parallel processing workloads without the premium cost of higher-end accelerator models. The lack of local storage requires careful architectural planning for disk-heavy tasks, but the dedicated CPU allocation and high network bandwidth mitigate potential bottlenecks. This server is optimized for workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, distributed data processing, and GPU-accelerated database queries.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a bare-metal, GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It features 96 dedicated physical cores on Intel Xeon 8163 processors with an x86_64 architecture, paired with 384.0 GB of system memory. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with a single thread per core, the instance ensures dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead. The instance integrates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, providing a total of 64 GB of VRAM to accelerate graphics, deep learning, and parallel computing tasks. While it lacks local storage, it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps to support high-throughput external storage configurations. This hardware profile is designed for machine learning inference, video transcoding, distributed data processing, and GPU-accelerated database queries.
